elements.element: Customer owns deliverables and work product created for it, with Vendor assignment
elements.evidence: "TrueLink hereby assigns to Client all right, title and interest in the deliverables and work product of the Support Services created for Client, which Client shall own"

Untouched Section 2(d): "TrueLink retains all of its ownership and license rights in the Interface"; insertion limits Client ownership to deliverables/work product and licences (not assigns) embedded TrueLink IP

elements.element: Perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to Vendor IP embedded in deliverables
elements.evidence: "grants Client a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free license to any TrueLink Intellectual Property embedded in such deliverables and work product"

elements.element: Customer retains all rights in Customer Data
elements.evidence: "Client retains all right, title and interest in Client's Intellectual Property and all data provided by or on behalf of Client or generated through Client's use of the Interface"
"No joint ownership of any intellectual property is created by this Agreement."

elements.element: Vendor owns generic tools and know-how
elements.evidence: No reference to generic tools or know-how anywhere; only "ownership and license rights in the Interface"

elements.element: Customer licence to deliverables that is perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free
elements.evidence: Licence granted is only to embedded TrueLink IP and omits "worldwide": "perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free license to any TrueLink Intellectual Property embedded"

elements.element: Licence rights to use, modify and sublicense deliverables for Customer's business
elements.evidence: No use/modify/sublicense verbs appear; deliverables are assigned outright instead

reasons: The inserted subsection (e) completes every atomic element of the preferred position: assignment and Customer ownership of deliverables/work product, a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to embedded TrueLink IP, Customer retention of its IP and data, and an express no-joint-ownership statement.

Vendor pre-existing IP retention is preserved by the untouched Section 2(d) Interface ownership sentence, and the insertion assigns only deliverables/work product while merely licensing embedded Vendor IP.

Fallback is independently incomplete (no generic tools/know-how ownership, no worldwide use/modify/sublicense licence in deliverables), but that is irrelevant because the drafter's locked target level (preferred) is satisfied and the levels must not be mixed.
Minimality holds: a single concise new subsection was added where no Customer-side ownership clause existed; no other sentence was rewritten and no boilerplate was imported.

Intent preserved: the Section 8(d) Credit Data licence is expressly carved out ("Subject to the license granted in Section 8(d)"), avoiding contradiction, and no undefined term or dangling mechanic is introduced.
No redline of unrelated commercial terms; classification is compliant at the preferred position.
